intro:
Relocating within or to Attleborough? Jimmys Removals provides an expert, insured moving service focused on this vibrant community in eastern Nuneaton. Surrounding the village green, Bull Street, and Kem Street, as well as new housing tracts toward Crowhill and the Coventry Canal, our crew handles moves of all scales. We arrive in modern 3.5-tonne Luton vans with tail lifts, ratchet strapping, and padded covers to keep your belongings pristine.

Our team is known for courteous service and methodical organisation. We unbolt cumbersome bedframes, wrap polished surfaces, and manoeuvre hefty sideboards down awkward turns without scuffing hallway walls. Transparent quotations give you complete financial certainty, with no surprise surcharges on key handover.
